jobs.occupation: Laboratory Technician / Laboratory Manager (Laborleiter/in)
jobs.description: The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.The Division of Soft-Tissue Sarcoma at the Hopp Children’s Cancer Center (KiTZ) - a joint institution of the Heidelberg University Hospital and the German Cancer Research Center - is seeking, starting between December 2026 and January 2027, a Laboratory Technician / Laboratory Manager.Your TasksWe are a friendly and motivated laboratory with German and international researchers working to understand tumor biology and generate new models to help find treatments for children and adults with sarcoma. The candidate’s tasks will comprise lab management, cell culture, plasmid preps, support in various molecular biology techniques and training of new laboratory members on specifc tasks when required. Occasional mouse work may be required. Routine animal work is covered by a dedicated technician, with the successful candidate only expected to assist during periods of absence or in exceptional circumstances. While the position involves both administrative and laboratory work, there is some flexibility in the balance between these two areas, depending on the successful candidate’s interests. The candidate will work together with other members of the laboratory and will be trained in the various tasks.Your ProfileThe ideal candidate should:- Be motivated, responsible, and well organised- Have completed vocational training as a biological laboratory technician or hold a comparable qualification- Have experience in cell culture and standard molecular biology techniques- Have basic experience in handling mice, ideally hold a FELASA certificate- Be willing to train technical trainees and early-career scientists in specific laboratory techniques- Have a working knowledge of English and German- Have good communication skills and the ability to document laboratory work accuratelyWHAT MAKES THIS POSITION SPECIAL- Training in a range of laboratory techniques- An interesting and varied role, with the opportunity to contribute actively, alongside the wider research group, to laboratory organisation and the group’s future development- Friendly, collaborative, and international working environment- Workplace in the new KiTZ building and access to the modern, state-of-the-art infrastructure of the DKFZ campus- Opportunities for continuing education, professional development, and career progressionWe Offer- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level- 30 days of vacation per year- Flexible working hours- Remuneration according to TV-L incl. occupational pension plan and capital-forming payments- Possibility of part-time work- Family-friendly working environment- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket- Unleash your full potential: targeted offers for your personal development to further develop your talents- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-beingAre you interested?Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!Contact:Dr. Ana BanitoPhone: +49 (0)6221/42-1581​Duration: The position is initially limited to 2 years with the possibility of prolongation.Application Deadline: November 4, 2026Applications by e-mail cannot be accepted.Please also note that we cannot return applications submitted by post.We are convinced that an innovative research and working environment thrives on the diversity of its employees. Therefore, we welcome applications from talented people, regardless of gender, cultural background, nationality, ethnicity, sexual identity, physical ability, religion and age. People with severe disabilities are given preference if they have the same aptitude.Notice: We are subject to the regulations of the Infection Protection Act (IfSG). Therefore, all our employees must provide proof of immunity against measles.

jobs.occupation: Bid Manager (f/m/d) for Surge Arresters (Ingenieur/in - Energietechnik)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day In this role, you are responsible for the efficient and accurate preparation of quotations for the global surge arrester market. Your proposals are based on customer-specific technical requirements, established product solutions, and applicable framework agreements.You support both internal and external stakeholders by providing timely clarifications and ensuring a high level of customer service throughout the quotation process. In addition, you are responsible for the accurate processing and booking of customer orders, thereby ensuring a seamless transition from sales to execution.Through your structured, process-oriented approach, you enable regional sales colleagues to further develop business opportunities and strengthen customer relationships. The quality, accuracy, and reliability of your work form the foundation for the efficient execution of downstream operational processes.You collaborate closely with colleagues across the organization, actively engage with adjacent functions on complex topics, communicate transparently, and contribute to the continuous improvement of existing processes by constructively challenging established ways of working.Your daily work is supported by SAP, including a powerful integrated configuration tool, as well as the Microsoft Office suite.How You’ll Make an Impact * Commitment to delivering high customer satisfaction, exceptional service quality, and sustainable business growth* Active contribution to process optimization and continuous improvement initiatives* Support and promotion of a collaborative learning culture and knowledge sharing environment* Customer-centric service excellence and responsiveness to evolving market requirements* Ownership and accountability for operational effectiveness and business success* Dedication to advancing the transition toward a CO₂-free and sustainable energy futureWhat You Bring* Advanced technical understanding of energy transmission and distribution components and applications* Strong commitment to professional development, continuous learning, and effective communication* Rapid comprehension of complex topics and proficiency in utilizing IT tools, including SAP and MS Office* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English* Strong teamwork and collaboration capabilities within cross-functional and international environments* Proactive and committed working style, combined with a high level of adaptability and initiative About the TeamOur Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs#RPO

jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day This position involves the technical and disciplinary leadership of a team of IT/OT technicians, the coordination of IT/OT projects, and the responsibility for maintaining and further developing the local IT/OT infrastructure.The Local IT Team Lead works closely with other departments to ensure the seamless and high quality delivery of IT/OT services. In addition, he or she, together with the team, is integrated into global support and project structures and provides support for international initiatives as required.How You’ll Make an Impact * Leadership, guidance, and performance management of the local IT/OT team, including mentoring and feedback* Coordination and prioritization of local and global IT/OT support requests, including first‑ and second‑line technical support* Setup, configuration, monitoring, and maintenance of local and global IT/OT infrastructure (servers, networks, security systems, and end‑user devices)* Planning, leadership, and execution of local and international IT/OT projects and strategic initiatives* Cross‑functional collaboration with internal departments and the global IT organization to ensure stable operation of the global DT environment and remote site support* Compliance assurance with IT/OT policies and best practices, including documentation, ticket tracking, continuous process improvement, and evaluation of emerging technologiesWhat You Bring* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline* Proven experience in IT/OT support or a comparable role, with leadership experience as an advantage* Strong knowledge of IT/OT systems, hardware, software, networking, and troubleshooting methodologies* Familiarity with IT service management frameworks (e.g. ITIL), relevant certifications (e.g. CompTIA A+, Network+), and SAP knowledge as a plus* Proficiency in the local language and English; additional language skills as an advantage* Strong personal attributes, including problem‑solving capability, communication skills, attention to detail, customer orientation, adaptability, a hands‑on mindset, and commitment to continuous learning About the TeamOur Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. jobs.occupation: Internship in Flight Control Systems (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description: About usAirbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.Job descriptionIn order to support the X-Labs department, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for aInternship in Flight Control Systems (d/f/m)Are you looking for an internship and want to get to know the work of a Systems Engineer (d/f/m)?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the X-Labs department, as an intern (d/f/m)!- Location: Taufkirchen/Ottobrunn- Start: as soon as possible- Duration: 6 months- Within the X-Labs organization, we are targeting advanced technological breakthroughs that could be key enablers of the next generation products at Airbus.By exploration of new air vehicle concepts and application of disruptive technology bricks we are driving a step change in air vehicle performance and allowing us to significantly rethink air vehicle design. These advances are opening up the design space and enabling us to look at new concepts and new markets previously impossible to envisage.Your locationOur site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.Your benefits- Attractive salary and work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.- Traveling overseas or within Germany (team events) is possible after consultation and agreement from the department.- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.- Work with modern/diversified technologies.- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.Your tasks and responsibilitiesWe are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Flight Controls Engineering Intern to join our dynamic flight systems team. In this role, you will gain invaluable hands-on experience designing, testing, and integrating advanced flight control systems for our next-generation aircraft. Mentored by senior engineers, you will have the opportunity to take ownership of impactful projects, applying theoretical aerospace concepts to real-world hardware and software challenges.- Flight Control Law Development & Simulation: Assist in the design, modeling, and refinement of flight control laws to meet performance and handling requirements.- Develop FCC dynamic algorithms: Design and optimize dynamic algorithms for the Flight Control Computer (FCC) to ensure reliable aircraft responsiveness.- Implement control strategies in MATLAB/Simulink: Translate aerodynamic data and control theory into high-fidelity digital models.- Conduct Software-In-The-Loop (SIL) simulations to validate control architecture stability: Run rigorous tests to analyze system performance and safety margins.- Hardware: Lead trade studies to evaluate, select, and integrate core flight control hardware for your specific project scope, ensuring seamless communication between sensors, actuators, and the FCC.Desired skills and qualifications- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) within Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.- Language skills: English Fluent, good German skills would be an advantage.- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.- Previous project team experience (e.g., Design Build Fly, Formula SAE, university rocketry/UAV teams).- Familiarity with simulation environments like Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) or Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL).- Exposure to hardware integration, avionics, or basic embedded systems.- Eagerness to learn and ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!#MYCYMThis job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growthBy submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.
